snippet.title: Light Source Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Light Source is the brand new 2d Turn-Based RPG releasing on the 3rd of November.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4989280/Light_Source/

Follow Bulb and bring back the light to the dim kingdom of Lumeria, in this dark 2D turn-based RPG. Help the locals and battle your way through increasingly harder odds while uncovering the secrets hidden within the decaying kingdom.
